title: No-Show Margin Schedule for Extended Imaging and Procedure Authorizations
content:
The no-show margin of the added validity on an extended Advanced Imaging Prior Authorization or Outpatient Procedure Prior Authorization (Referrals & Prior Authorizations) follows the no-show fees assessed on the patient's In-Person Appointments in the 12 months before the handling date. A fee later waived still counts as assessed.

| No-show fees assessed in those 12 months | No-show margin added to the validity |
|---|---|
| two or more | the repeat no-show margin of 14 days |
| exactly one | the single no-show margin of 7 days |
| none | no margin |

The margin is a count of calendar days added to the added validity of the extension.

**Records read.** The no-show fees counted are those assessed on any of the patient's In-Person Appointments and dated within the 12 months before the handling date, whether or not they were later waived.

**Illustrations (hypothetical histories).**

- Three no-show fees in the past year, one of them waived: three are counted, so the margin is 14 days.
- One no-show fee five months ago: the margin is 7 days.
- A no-show fee from fifteen months ago and none since: none falls in the 12 months, so there is no margin.
